Fort Lauderdale Beach and the reef offsh.alt: The white curved wave wall and "Riomar" marker along the A1A beachfront promenade in Fort Lauderdale, with blue beach umbrellas and the ocean beyond
Fort Lauderdale Beach and the reef offsh.caption: The wave wall along Fort Lauderdale's A1A beachfront, at the Riomar crossing.
Fort Lauderdale Beach and the reef offsh.author: Infrogmation of New Orleans
Fort Lauderdale Beach and the reef offsh.modificationNotice: Resized, cropped for display and converted to WebP. The adaptation is released under the same licence.
Fort Lauderdale Beach and the reef offsh.verification: Downloaded the original from Wikimedia Commons and inspected it: the file's own title and Commons category "Florida State Road A1A in Fort Lauderdale, Florida" and "Central Beach, Fort Lauderdale" match this pick's beach strip, and the "Riomar" wave-wall marker is a known fixture of this exact beachfront promenade; beachgoers under the umbrellas are moderate distance and not close-up, not the subject.

The Water Taxi through the Venice of Ame.note: A hop-on hop-off boat route through the Intracoastal and New River, not a single visitable place.

Pier Sixty-Six and the rotating Pier Top.note: The only Wikimedia Commons photo of this resort is a decades-old image licensed plain "Public domain," which is not in Wayfind's allowed licence list (CC0, or CC BY/CC BY-SA at 2.0, 3.0 or 4.0), and it predates the resort's recent luxury revamp; the property is not indexed in Wayfind's inventory either. Pass 2 (2026-09-23): Searched Openverse for 'Pier Sixty-Six Fort Lauderdale', 'Pier 66 Fort Lauderdale tower' (source=flickr), and 'Pier 66 Hotel Fort Lauderdale'. Found only CC BY-NC-ND (US Coast Guard, unrelated) and CC BY-NC-SA ('Pier 66' by bobdole369, 2009) Flickr photos, both disallowed licences; a third, nominally CC BY 2.0 result's Flickr page now redirects to Flickr's Explore feed instead of the photo, so it could not be verified live and was not used. No usable photo of the tower or rotating Pier Top found.

Las Olas Boulevard's restaurant wave.note: A wave of new restaurant openings (Little Hen, Skinny Louie) along a boulevard, not a single visitable place.

The Fort, the world's first pickleball s.note: No Wikimedia Commons photo exists for this brand-new stadium; Wayfind's inventory shows only a Google Places photo, which is not licensed for reuse. Pass 2 (2026-09-23): Searched Openverse for 'The Fort pickleball Fort Lauderdale' — zero results. This brand-new venue has no CC-licensed Flickr or Commons coverage yet.

Huizenga Park, rebuilt.note: No Wikimedia Commons photo exists of the park's recent rebuild; Wayfind's inventory shows only a Google Places photo, which is not licensed for reuse. Pass 2 (2026-09-23): Searched Openverse for 'Huizenga Park Fort Lauderdale' — zero results. No CC-licensed photo of the rebuilt park found on Flickr or Commons.

An Everglades airboat morning.note: A bookable airboat tour offered by multiple operators, not a single visitable place.

Las Olas Beach at sunrise.note: The only allowed-licence Commons photo is dominated by a temporary pink-ribbon sculpture; US freedom of panorama does not cover sculpture, so it cannot be used without the artist's licence. Needs a clean beach photo.
